cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pulled my ribbon when you pulled yours. That pretty ribbon has brought the tent down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I untied a bow on a parcel. Yours was tied to the tent's support rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, releasing the decoration. Nobody told the ribbon it was holding anything up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The pole fell onto the cake. You need to tell the baker what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her the ribbon brought the pole down. I never touched her cake.
